programs.name: subinbigcsv
programs.purpose: Keep traces near selected CDPs and optionally renumber their headers to form larger bins.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUBINBIGCSV - Make Some CDPs Larger and Delete All Traces Outside Them.

params.name: rfile
params.description: Input grid K-file; alternatively supply a complete grid on the command line.

params.name: grid_xa, grid_ya, grid_xb, grid_yb, grid_xc, grid_yc, grid_wb, grid_wc
params.description: Grid definition parameters, required together when defining a grid on the command line.

params.name: igiout
params.description: Three integers specifying first, last and increment; required unless igilist is supplied.

params.name: igilist
params.description: Selected inline indices; alternative to igiout.

params.name: igcout
params.description: Three integers specifying crossline first, last and increment; required for a grid unless igclist is supplied.

params.name: igclist
params.description: Selected crossline indices; alternative to igcout.

params.name: igiext
params.description: Low and high inline extents; a single value supplies both.

params.name: igcext
params.description: Low and high crossline extents; a single value supplies both.

params.name: intype
params.description: Input location mode; 0 selects 3 with a grid or -2 without one.

params.name: qout
params.description: Optional output Q-file of selected locations.

params.name: recdp
params.description: Reset CDP to the selected center.

params.name: reigi
params.description: Reset inline index; unavailable without a grid.

params.name: reigc
params.description: Reset crossline index; unavailable without a grid.

params.name: check
params.description: Print grid checks.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Grid coordinate calculations use double precision and rounding at cell boundaries can change assignments. Integer range calculations mix floating-point and integer arithmetic.
programs.difficulty_reason: Grid conversion, selection ranges and lists, and several input-header modes require substantial state and branching.

test_cases.description: Select 2D CDP centers with an extent.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | subinbigcsv igiout=1,15,4 igiext=1 recdp=1 > out.su

test_cases.description: Select an explicit 2D center list without renumbering.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | subinbigcsv igilist=2,8,14 igiext=1 recdp=0 > out.su

programs.name: subincsv
programs.purpose: Resolve a 3D grid or point-number definition and use it to assign trace bin headers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUBINCSV - 3D Grid Resolve and output and assign traces to cdps (cells).

params.name: rfile
params.description: Input K-file; command-line values override it.

params.name: wfile
params.description: Output K-file; required when there are no input traces.

params.name: bintype
params.description: Binning mode; may also be read from the K-file.

params.name: offset
params.description: Whether to recompute offset.

params.name: check
params.description: Print grid checks.

params.name: grid_xa, grid_ya, grid_xb, grid_yb, grid_xc, grid_yc, grid_wb, grid_wc
params.description: Grid corners and cell widths; required for grid modes unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: point_crz, point_cru, point_csz, point_csu
params.description: Receiver and source point-to-CDP coefficients; required for bintype 20 unless supplied by rfile.

params.name: rpkey
params.description: Receiver point header for bintype 20.

params.name: spkey
params.description: Source point header for bintype 20.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Grid geometry uses double precision, square roots and rounding; coordinates on cell boundaries and lrint results can depend on rounding and platform math.
programs.difficulty_reason: Multiple binning modes, grid geometry, K-file handling and header conversions require substantial branching.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | subincsv bintype=30 grid_xa=0 grid_ya=0 grid_xb=100 grid_yb=0 grid_xc=0 grid_yc=100 grid_wb=10 grid_wc=10 offset=0 > out.su
suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | subincsv bintype=20 point_crz=0 point_cru=1 point_csz=0 point_csu=1 rpkey=gaps spkey=grnlof > out.su

programs.name: subinqcsv
programs.purpose: Interpolate spatially indexed parameter records and write them as a Q-file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUBINQCSV - Input Q-records or parameters. interpolate, output Q-records.

params.name: rfile
params.description: Input 3D grid K-file; without it the program uses 2D locations.

params.name: qin
params.description: Input Q-file; alternatively supply location and value parameters.

params.name: qout
params.description: Output Q-file.

params.name: extrapi
params.description: Inline or 2D spatial extrapolation mode.

params.name: extrapc
params.description: Crossline extrapolation mode.

params.name: extrapt
params.description: Independent-dimension extrapolation mode.

params.name: inloc
params.description: Input location representation.

params.name: keyloc
params.description: 2D input location name.

params.name: check
params.description: Print grid checks.

params.name: iecho
params.description: Output all requested locations, or echo input locations with or without tuple interpolation.

params.name: igiout
params.default: computed: minimum input or grid index, maximum input or grid index, 1
params.description: Output inline or 2D location range.

params.name: igcout
params.default: computed: grid crossline range and increment 1; 1,1,1 without a grid
params.description: Output crossline range.

params.name: outind
params.description: Output independent-dimension range; unspecified trailing values are 3000 and 1000.

params.name: outlist
params.description: Explicit output independent-dimension values.

params.name: invp2
params.description: Select names whose values use inverse-square weighting.

params.name: ename
params.description: Names to omit from output.

params.name: formxy
params.description: Output coordinate format.

params.name: formtv
params.description: Output value format.

params.name: cdp and supported non-tuple header names, numa, numb, vuma, vumb
params.description: Input location and scalar-value lists when qin is absent; the names required by inloc must be present.

params.name: tupa, offs, tims, tnmo, dpth, vels, vnmo, tupb, vupa
params.description: Repeated input tuple lists when qin is absent.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Interpolation and inverse-square weighting use double precision and square roots; sorting, rounding and floating-point evaluation order affect output. Several string allocations are too small for their terminating NUL, including the default invp2 string, causing undefined behavior.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines Q-file parsing, multidimensional interpolation, tuple handling and grid geometry across more than 1500 lines.

test_cases.description: Interpolate two 2D scalar locations; run with stdin and stdout attached to a terminal.
Echo velocity tuples; run with stdin and stdout attached to a terminal.
test_cases.command: subinqcsv qout=out.csv cdp=1,5 tims=0,1000 vels=1500,2000 vels=1600,2100 iecho=2

programs.name: subinxxcsv
programs.purpose: Expand or shrink a 3D grid and exchange its corners.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUBINXXCSV - Expand Size and Exchange Corners of 3D Grid Definition.

params.name: rfile
params.description: Input grid K-file; required when wfile is supplied by the current code.

params.name: wfile
params.description: Output K-file, different from rfile.

params.name: bintype
params.description: Copied bin type.

params.name: grid_xa, grid_ya, grid_xb, grid_yb, grid_xc, grid_yc, grid_wb, grid_wc
params.description: Grid definition values, normally read from rfile.

params.name: igilow
params.description: Cells added at the low inline end.

params.name: igihigh
params.description: Cells added at the high inline end.

params.name: igclow
params.description: Cells added at the low crossline end.

params.name: igchigh
params.description: Cells added at the high crossline end.

params.name: iflip
params.description: Corner exchange mode.

params.name: check
params.description: Print grid checks.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Double-precision grid calculations and coordinate rounding can change cell assignments. Some gvals elements are read without initialization if expected values are missing; several allocations do not leave space for terminating NUL characters.
programs.difficulty_reason: Grid geometry, K-file updates and several corner exchange modes require nontrivial state.

test_cases.description: Expand a grid and flip its axes; both programs require terminal stdin and stdout.
test_cases.command: subincsv bintype=30 grid_xa=0 grid_ya=0 grid_xb=100 grid_yb=0 grid_xc=0 grid_yc=100 grid_wb=10 grid_wc=10 wfile=in.csv && subinxxcsv rfile=in.csv wfile=out.csv igilow=1 igchigh=2 iflip=1

test_cases.description: Shrink and reverse a grid; both programs require terminal stdin and stdout.
test_cases.command: subincsv bintype=30 grid_xa=0 grid_ya=0 grid_xb=100 grid_yb=0 grid_xc=0 grid_yc=100 grid_wb=10 grid_wc=10 wfile=in.csv && subinxxcsv rfile=in.csv wfile=out.csv igilow=-1 igihigh=0 iflip=-1

programs.name: sucdpbin
programs.purpose: Assign each trace to the nearest CDP bin along a piecewise straight line.

params.name: xline
params.description: Increasing X coordinates defining the line.

params.name: yline
params.description: Y coordinates defining the line.

params.name: dcdp
params.description: Distance between bin centers.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print diagnostic information.

params.name: cdpmin
params.description: First bin number.

params.name: distmax
params.description: Maximum distance from a bin center.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Repeated float coordinate updates mix float and double sqrt and pow operations. The segment loop accesses xline[iseg+1] and yline[iseg+1] after incrementing iseg, potentially past the input arrays; bin arrays can also be overrun.
programs.difficulty_reason: Bin construction follows connected line segments and searches all generated bins for each trace.

test_cases.description: Bin traces along a straight line.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | sucdpbin xline=0,100 yline=0,0 dcdp=10 cdpmin=1 distmax=20 > out.su

test_cases.description: Exercise a bent line and diagnostics.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | sucdpbin xline=0,50,100 yline=0,10,0 dcdp=10 verbose=1 > out.su

programs.name: suchart
programs.purpose: Write pairs of selected trace-header values as binary floats for plotting.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUCHART - prepare data for x vs. y plot

params.name: key1
params.description: Abscissa header.

params.name: key2
params.description: Ordinate header.

params.name: outpar
params.description: Optional output parameter file; despite the selfdoc's null, the code creates no file when omitted.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Header values are converted to native float, which can lose precision for large integer or double values; binary output uses native float representation and byte order.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program reads two headers per trace and writes their float conversions.

test_cases.description: Write default source and receiver coordinates.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | suchart key1=sx key2=gx > chart.bin

test_cases.description: Write CDP and fold with a parameter file.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | suchart key1=cdp key2=nhs outpar=chart.par > chart.bin
